verdict.rationale: The evidence shows item-level sharing: the Graph createLink action creates typed sharing links on a driveItem, and admins can govern external sharing. However, nothing documents a viewer/commenter/editor/owner role model or how permissions inherit down folder hierarchies. missing for 10: documented permission roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner), folder-level permission inheritance and break-inheritance behavior, the permission-management API or admin docs, and independent corroboration.
